sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(fp.posting_key)
FROM fct_posting AS fp
JOIN mart_comp_by_family AS mcb
  ON fp.family = mcb.family
WHERE
  fp.is_open AND fp.remote_us AND fp.comp_mid_usd > mcb.p50 * 1.5
